verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but nothing in the evidence shows LaunchDarkly's core flag-management service can run on your own infrastructure. The Relay Proxy does run on-premises, but it only proxies the LaunchDarkly streaming API to internal clients, so it is an adjacent component that still depends on LaunchDarkly's hosted service. The federal offering is a separate FedRAMP-compliant instance and is not described as customer-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
